milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The terracotta building's front wall is at Z+4 relative to spawn, centered on X=0. Target is set to the center of the front wall entrance. Player must navigate near it and face it to 'find' it. Max distance of 16 allows detection as soon as the player looks toward the building.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The magenta glazed terracotta is at X+2, Y+1, Z+10 (right interior wall). Player must enter the building and get close enough to observe it. Max distance of 5 ensures the player has entered the building and is near the blocks, with facing tolerance of 60 degrees to confirm they are looking at it.

Uses count_in_box_at_most(kind='block') because yellow stained glass does NOT drop as an item without Silk Touch enchantment, so inventory_has cannot be used. Instead, we check that at least one of the 3 yellow stained glass blocks on the back wall has been removed (broken). The box encompasses all 3 glass block positions at Z+11, Y+2, X from -1 to +1. If at least one is mined, count drops from 3 to at most 2.
